title: Thinkers of Cernavodă: Mysterious Stone Age figurines discovered in a 7,000-year-old grave in Romania
caption:
🗿 Romania’s 7,000-year-old “Thinkers” are still a mystery.

Live Science reports that archaeologists uncovered the fired-clay pair in 1956 in a Stone Age grave at Cernavodă. One figure leans forward with his head in his hands; the other sits upright. Both are associated with the Late Neolithic Hamangia culture, around 5000 B.C.

Their purpose remains uncertain. Interpretations range from ritual or solar symbolism to mourners or a paired representation of masculine and feminine principles. None is confirmed.

Why do you think these small figures still feel so modern?
